records.jp: こんにちは。約束の場所って、ここで合ってる？
records.en_original: Good afternoon. Am I in the right place?
records.en_auxiliary: Hello. Am I in the right place?
records.en: Good afternoon. Am I in the right place?

records.jp: あ、待ってたよ！<CR>こっちこっちー
records.en_original: We've been waiting for you! Over here, over here!
records.en_auxiliary: We've been waiting for you! Over here, over here!
records.en: We've been waiting for you! Over here, over here!

records.jp: あなたたちが相談に乗ってくれるの？
records.en_original: Just to confirm, you three are the ones I'm supposed to consult, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Just to confirm, you three are the ones I'm supposed to consult, right?
records.en: Just to confirm, you three are the ones I'm supposed to consult, right?

records.jp: そうそう！　ユズたちに任せてっ
records.en_original: Bingo, bingo! You can count on us!
records.en_auxiliary: Bingo, bingo! You can count on us!
records.en: Bingo, bingo! You can count on us!

records.jp: そっか。今日はありがとう、本当に助かっちゃった。<CR>誰に相談しようかってずっと悩んでて
records.en_original: Well, I hope so. I really do appreciate your help; I had no idea who to talk to.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I hope so. I really do appreciate your help—I had no idea who to talk to.
records.en: Well, I hope so. I really do appreciate your help; I had no idea who to talk to.

records.jp: わかるよー、大事な話なら相談相手も慎重になるよね
records.en_original: For sure. When you've got something this delicate to deal with, you've gotta be careful who you ask.
records.en_auxiliary: For sure. When you're dealing with something this delicate, you've gotta be careful who you ask.
records.en: For sure. When you've got something this delicate to deal with, you've gotta be careful who you ask.

records.jp: えーと、あなたは……？
records.en_original: Er, by the way... Who are you?
records.en_auxiliary: Er, by the way... Who are you?
records.en: Er, by the way... Who are you?

records.jp: あ、同じクラスだけど、話したことはなかったわね。<CR>私は菅本しほり。よろしくね、日菜子ちゃん
records.en_original: We are in the same class, but I suppose we've never talked, have we? I'm Shihori Sugamoto. Pleasure to meet you, Hinako.
records.en_auxiliary: We're in the same class, but I suppose we've never talked, have we? I'm Shihori Sugamoto. Pleasure to meet you, Hinako.
records.en: We are in the same class, but I suppose we've never talked, have we? I'm Shihori Sugamoto. Pleasure to meet you, Hinako.

records.jp: よ、よろしく
records.en_original: L-Likewise.
records.en_auxiliary: L-likewise.
records.en: L-Likewise.

records.jp: さっそくだけど、相談内容について教えてくれる？
records.en_original: Okay, I hate to cut this short, but can you tell us WHY you want our help?
records.en_auxiliary: Okay, I hate to cut this short, but can you tell us what you need help with?
records.en: Okay, I hate to cut this short, but can you tell us WHY you want our help?

records.jp: あ、うん。実は最近、男子五人に立て続けに告白されちゃって
records.en_original: Oh, right. So, just recently, I've been asked out by five different boys in a row.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, right. So, just recently, I've been asked out by five different boys in a row.
records.en: Oh, right. So, just recently, I've been asked out by five different boys in a row.

records.jp: はー、一度に五人ってすっごいねー
records.en_original: Really? Five? That's just impressive!
records.en_auxiliary: Really? Five? That's impressive!
records.en: Really? Five? That's just impressive!

records.jp: ふうん、もてるんだね
records.en_original: You mut be the total package.
records.en_auxiliary: Wow, you're quite the popular one.
records.en: You mut be the total package.

records.jp: え、うーん、別にそういうわけじゃないんだけど……
records.en_original: Er, sorry, I didn't mean to sound like I was bragging...
records.en_auxiliary: Er, sorry, I didn't mean to sound like I was bragging...
records.en: Er, sorry, I didn't mean to sound like I was bragging...

records.jp: ――あっ、ちょっとごめんなさい
records.en_original: Oh sorry, can you give me moment?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, sorry, can you give me moment?
records.en: Oh sorry, can you give me moment?

records.jp: やっほー、どうしたの？
records.en_original: Heya! What's up?
records.en_auxiliary: Heya! What's up?
records.en: Heya! What's up?

records.jp: えっ、今日？　うーん、今日は……ごめんねぇ。<CR>夜まで予定が空いてないからパスで
records.en_original: Huh? Today? Um...sorry. My schedule's full until the end of the night, so I'm afraid I'll have to pass.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Today? Um...sorry. My schedule's full until the end of the night, so I'm afraid I'll have to pass.
records.en: Huh? Today? Um...sorry. My schedule's full until the end of the night, so I'm afraid I'll have to pass.

records.jp: うん、うん。ホントごめんね。<CR>また今度埋め合わせするから。またね
records.en_original: Uh-huh. Yeah. I'm really sorry. I promise I'll make it up to you later. Bye-bye.
records.en_auxiliary: Uh-huh. Yeah. I'm really sorry. I promise I'll make it up to you later. Bye-bye.
records.en: Uh-huh. Yeah. I'm really sorry. I promise I'll make it up to you later. Bye-bye.

records.jp: ごめんね、友達からの電話だった
records.en_original: Sorry about that, got a call from a friend.
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry about that, got a call from a friend.
records.en: Sorry about that, got a call from a friend.

records.jp: 電話の声、男子だったけど……
records.en_original: I...could have sworn that was a boy's voice.
records.en_auxiliary: I could've sworn that was a boy's voice, though.
records.en: I...could have sworn that was a boy's voice.

records.jp: デートのお誘い？
records.en_original: Sounded like date number six, to me.
records.en_auxiliary: Was he asking you out on a date?
records.en: Sounded like date number six, to me.

records.jp: デート？　うーん、ただの買い物のお誘いかな？
records.en_original: A date? No way. He was just inviting me to go shopping.
records.en_auxiliary: A date? No way. He was just inviting me to go shopping.
records.en: A date? No way. He was just inviting me to go shopping.

records.jp: 前に好きなコスメの新作が出たから、<CR>欲しいなって話してたの
records.en_original: I've been telling him about a new beauty product released by my favorite company and said I wanted to get it.
records.en_auxiliary: I've been telling him about a new beauty product released by my favorite brand and said I wanted to get it.
records.en: I've been telling him about a new beauty product released by my favorite company and said I wanted to get it.

records.jp: そうしたら、放課後に買いに行かないかって
records.en_original: So he wanted to see if we could go buy it together after school.
records.en_auxiliary: So he wanted to see if we could go buy it together after school.
records.en: So he wanted to see if we could go buy it together after school.

records.jp: コスメって……化粧だよね。<CR>化粧なんかしていいの？
records.en_original: Beauty product? You mean like, makeup, right? Are we even allowed to wear that here?
records.en_auxiliary: Beauty product? You mean like, makeup, right? Are we even allowed to wear that here?
records.en: Beauty product? You mean like, makeup, right? Are we even allowed to wear that here?

records.jp: 化粧なんかって……日菜子ちゃんはメイクしないの？
records.en_original: ...Hinako, are you telling me you don't wear makeup?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Hinako, are you telling me you don't wear makeup?
records.en: ...Hinako, are you telling me you don't wear makeup?

records.jp: う、うん
records.en_original: Y-Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yeah...
records.en: Y-Yeah...

records.jp: （バレエのステージではしてたけど、あれはステージ用だし）
records.en_original: (I mean, I've worn some for ballet, but stage makeup is different...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I mean, I've worn some for ballet, but stage makeup is different...)
records.en: (I mean, I've worn some for ballet, but stage makeup is different...)

records.jp: えっと、お肌のケアとかはしてるよね？
records.en_original: Er... Do you have any skin care routine at all?
records.en_auxiliary: Er... Do you have any skin care routine at all?
records.en: Er... Do you have any skin care routine at all?

records.jp: ……特には
records.en_original: ...Not really.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Not really.
records.en: ...Not really.

records.jp: うそ……日焼け止めとかも使ってないの？<CR>今の時期は紫外線が強いから、曇りの日でも油断できないんだよ？
records.en_original: No way... Not even sunscreen? The sun's been so strong lately, you can't even let your guard down on cloudy days!
records.en_auxiliary: No way... Not even sunscreen? The sun's been so strong lately, you can't even let your guard down on cloudy days!
records.en: No way... Not even sunscreen? The sun's been so strong lately, you can't even let your guard down on cloudy days!

records.jp: そ、そうなんだ……
records.en_original: I-Is that so...?
records.en_auxiliary: I-is that so?
records.en: I-Is that so...?

records.jp: 信じられない！　下地もやってないなんて。<CR>きれいな肌してるんだから、ちゃんとしないともったいないよ
records.en_original: I can't believe it! You don't even use any foundation! What a waste, not taking care of your beautiful skin!
records.en_auxiliary: I can't believe it! You don't even use any foundation? What a waste, not taking care of your beautiful skin!
records.en: I can't believe it! You don't even use any foundation! What a waste, not taking care of your beautiful skin!

records.jp: そういうのは、全然考えたことなかった。<CR>……ユズとライムもしてるの？
records.en_original: I've really never thought about it before... Yuzu, Lime, do you two take care of your skin?
records.en_auxiliary: I've really never thought about it before... Yuzu, Lime, do you two take care of your skin?
records.en: I've really never thought about it before... Yuzu, Lime, do you two take care of your skin?

records.jp: ユズたちは……ねえ、ライム？
records.en_original: Well... What would you say, Lime?
records.en_auxiliary: Well... What would you say, Lime?
records.en: Well... What would you say, Lime?

records.jp: それなりに？
records.en_original: A little bit, sure.
records.en_auxiliary: A little bit, sure.
records.en: A little bit, sure.

records.jp: そう、なんだ
records.en_original: I guess I'm the exception.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess I'm the exception.
records.en: I guess I'm the exception.

records.jp: びっくりした……女の子はみんなしてて当然だと思ってた
records.en_original: I'm kind of shocked. I figured every girl wore at least a little makeup.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm kind of shocked. I figured every girl wore at least a little makeup.
records.en: I'm kind of shocked. I figured every girl wore at least a little makeup.

records.jp: 今まではバレエが私の世界の全部だったし……<CR>メイクとかおしゃれとかは考えたことなかったかも
records.en_original: My interests didn't extend far beyond ballet until now... I've never really thought about makeup or fashion.
records.en_auxiliary: My interests didn't extend far beyond ballet until now... I've never really thought about makeup or fashion.
records.en: My interests didn't extend far beyond ballet until now... I've never really thought about makeup or fashion.

records.jp: うーん、それってもったいなくない？<CR>女の子としての人生半分くらい損してるよ？
records.en_original: Hmm... That's such a shame. It's like you've missed out on half the joy of　<CR>being a girl.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... That's such a shame. It's like you've missed out on half the joy of being a girl.
records.en: Hmm... That's such a shame. It's like you've missed out on half the joy of　<CR>being a girl.

records.jp: それは言い過ぎな気が……
records.en_original: That seems a little excessive...
records.en_auxiliary: That seems a little excessive...
records.en: That seems a little excessive...

records.jp: 言い過ぎじゃないって！<CR>女子力は戦闘力なんだから！
records.en_original: Not at all! A girl's beauty is power!
records.en_auxiliary: Not at all! A girl's beauty is power!
records.en: Not at all! A girl's beauty is power!

records.jp: よーし、わかった。私がメイクの良さを教えてあげる
records.en_original: Right, I've decided! I'm going to teach you the joy of makeup!
records.en_auxiliary: Right, I've decided! I'm going to teach you the joy of makeup!
records.en: Right, I've decided! I'm going to teach you the joy of makeup!

records.jp: さ、行きましょう
records.en_original: Come on, let's get started!
records.en_auxiliary: Come on, let's get started!
records.en: Come on, let's get started!

records.jp: いや私は――
records.en_original: No, that's really--
records.en_auxiliary: No, that's not really—
records.en: No, that's really--

records.jp: いいから来るの。一度経験すると絶対ハマるから！<CR>ほらほら
records.en_original: It'll be fine. Once you see what it's like to pretty yourself up, you'll be hooked! Off we go!
records.en_auxiliary: It'll be fine. Once you see what it's like to pretty yourself up, you'll be hooked! Off we go!
records.en: It'll be fine. Once you see what it's like to pretty yourself up, you'll be hooked! Off we go!

records.jp: ちょ、ちょっと押さないで
records.en_original: H-Hey, you don't have to push me!
records.en_auxiliary: H-hey, you don't have to push me!
records.en: H-Hey, you don't have to push me!

records.jp: ……ユズ、どうする？
records.en_original: ...What should we do about this?
records.en_auxiliary: ...What should we do about this?
records.en: ...What should we do about this?

records.jp: もちろん行くよ！<CR>ヒナちゃんがメイクした姿、ライムも気になるでしょ？
records.en_original: Go after them, of course! Aren't you curious to see how Hina looks with makeup on?
records.en_auxiliary: Go after them, of course! Aren't you curious about how Hina looks with makeup on?
records.en: Go after them, of course! Aren't you curious to see how Hina looks with makeup on?

records.jp: そうだね、行こうか
records.en_original: I really am. Shall we?
records.en_auxiliary: I really am. Shall we?
records.en: I really am. Shall we?
